subject: Elevated 5xx rate observed — hosted API (May 19)
content:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <priya@livemart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Elevated 5xx rate observed — hosted API (May 19)

Hi Priyanka,

Quick heads-up: our monitoring triggered an elevated 5xx error rate for LiveMart requests to the /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings endpoints between ~09:20–09:42 PT. We’ve opened an incident and published an initial notice on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RI-20260519-1

I’m CC’ing Marissa and Grace from Incident Response. Can you confirm whether your team is seeing customer-facing errors (e.g., request failures in the app or queued retries)? Any sample request IDs or timestamps you can forward will help triage.

Immediate steps we’ve taken:
- Activated additional routing to a standby capacity pool for LiveMart traffic.
- Raised autoscale limits in the US-west pool.
- Captured stack traces and a snapshot of the affected requests (attached stub: livemart_error_snaps_20260519.zip).

We’ll provide an ETA for a mitigation in the next 30 minutes. Sorry for the disruption — we’re treating this as high priority.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----

From: Priyanka Rao <priya@livemart.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: support@livemart.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:52:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx rate observed — hosted API (May 19)

Alex — thanks for the heads-up. We are definitely seeing elevated errors in production (users complaining chat responses failing). Examples: request-id=lm-20260519-9981 (09:24:12 PT), lm-20260519-10017 (09:30:41 PT). Both are POST /v1/generate calls. We temporarily disabled retry logic to reduce client congestion.

We appreciate the quick action. Please let us know if you need anything else from our side (logs, account tokens to replicate).

— Priyanka Rao
Senior PM, LiveMart

On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 10:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
> To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Priyanka Rao <priya@livemart.com>
> Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
> Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx rate observed — hosted API (May 19)
>
> Priyanka — thanks for the IDs. Internal triage notes below. I’m pasting the relevant bits for transparency.
>
> Summary of findings (09:20–09:42 PT window):
> - Root symptom: transient worker pool overload combined with a serialization bug causing a small fraction of generator tasks to exceed a service-level memory threshold and return 5xx.
> - Impacted routes: /v1/generate (primary), /v1/embeddings (secondary).
> - Scope for LiveMart: ~0.6% of requests in the window failed with 500/502. Latency for successful requests rose p95 by ~420ms.
>
> Actions taken (real-time):
> - Shifted LiveMart traffic away from the saturated worker group to a warm standby cluster (reducing observed 5xx rate to baseline).
> - Temporarily disabled a non-critical prefetch path that exacerbated memory usage.
> - Backfilled request traces and pushed logs to the incident artifact (incident_detailed_log_20260519.txt).
>
> Next steps (post-incident):
> - Root cause follow-up: deploy a serialization guard and a mitigation that prevents the worker from queuing oversized jobs. Target deploy: 2026-05-20 02:00 PT (can expedite if LiveMart requests elevated impact).
> - Postmortem: a short RCA will be published to the Drive link and we’ll schedule a review call with your team tomorrow.
>
> Priyanka — per your note about retries, that was the right temporary step; we’ll include guidance in the follow-up on recommended retry/backoff settings while we roll the fix.
>
> I’ll keep this thread updated with the deployment and verification timeline.
>
> — Marissa Cole
> Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
>
> 
Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
To: Priyanka Rao <priya@livemart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Subject: Follow-up: incident summary + next steps (LiveMart)

Priyanka — thanks again for the quick confirmation and for forwarding the request IDs.

Short update: the immediate mitigation held, LiveMart’s 5xx rate returned to baseline by ~10:05 PT after traffic was shifted and the prefetch path was disabled. We completed a targeted patch verification in staging and will rollout the serialization guard to production at 02:00 PT tomorrow (2026-05-20).

We opened a PagerDuty incident PD-45219 and a post-incident doc (linked): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-inc-POSTMORTEM

Planned follow-up:
- Postmortem doc (short RCA) published by EOD 2026-05-20.
- 30-minute sync with your engineering leads to review impact and mitigation options: proposed times 2026-05-20 11:00 PT or 15:00 PT — please let us know which you prefer.

Attachments: incident_detailed_log_20260519.txt (sanitized traces), livemart_error_snaps_20260519.zip (request-level snapshots).

Apologies again for the disruption. We’ll include recommended retry/backoff guidance and a small configuration patch you can apply client-side to reduce the chance of a repeat while we deploy the server-side guard.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
